request: Ticket OLA-387: Ola's refusal counter (refusalOf in apps/activist-ai/frontdesk/faults.mjs) misses common ways of saying 'I cannot'. It returns null for "I don't have a way to send text messages.", "Sending texts isn't something I can do.", "I have no way of making phone calls.", "That's outside what I can do from this project." and "I can only work with files in this project, so I won't be able to call her.", so each is an uncounted refusal; and it labels "I can't send emails myself, but here's a draft" as cannot_here, because 'here\b' matches "here's". A test for it is at apps/activist-ai/frontdesk/test/faults-refusal.test.mjs, run it with: cd apps/activist-ai && node --test frontdesk/test/faults-refusal.test.mjs
